requirements: Analysts define portfolios and reporting currencies, then review data-quality warnings and approve daily valuations.
A nightly job receives closing exchange rates from an external market-data adapter and calculates portfolio valuations.
Operations staff can rerun a failed valuation without duplicating an already approved report.
Persist valuation inputs, results, approvals, and immutable published reports across VM restart on at least 50 GiB of mounted storage.
High availability is not required; deploy exactly one application VM and supply external credentials at runtime.
Use Java 21, Spring Boot, Gradle, and Docker, expose GET /health and GET /job-health, and listen on port 8080.
cloudConstraints: Deploy to AWS ap-northeast-2 with a monthly infrastructure budget of 350 USD. Terraform must provision or explicitly reference every required cloud resource.
